basic_details.job_title: CSIR-CMERI Security Assistant Recruitment 2027 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: CSIR-Central Mechanical Engineering Research Institute (CSIR-CMERI), Durgapur, under the Council of Scientific and Industrial Research, has invited applications for one unreserved Security Assistant post (Post Code 260201) at its Centre of Excellence for Farm Machinery (CoEFM), Ludhiana. The post carries Pay Level-6 (Rs. 35,400 - 1,12,400) and is for ex-servicemen, JCOs in Army or equivalent in other Paramilitary Forces with five years' experience in security work. The signed form must be sent by Registered/Speed Post to reach Durgapur by 6.00 PM on 12 January 2027.

important_dates.exam_date: Likely during February-March 2027; exact date and venue on the CSIR-CMERI website only

application_fee.details: The fee is paid through SB Collect and is non-refundable. It cannot be held in reserve for any other recruitment. Those claiming exemption must enclose the relevant certificate.

age_limit.details: The upper age limit is 28 years. Age, qualifications and experience are counted as on the last date for submission of applications, 12.01.2027, including for candidates from far flung areas. Date of birth in the application must match the Matriculation/Secondary certificate, and no later change is considered. | Ex-servicemen: the upper age limit is relaxable up to 03 years after deduction of the military service rendered from the actual age as on the closing date. The relaxation follows Government of India rules for Ex-Servicemen under Rule 2(c) of the Ex-Servicemen (Re-employment in Central Civil Services and Posts) Rules. It is not applicable to serving Armed Forces and Paramilitary personnel, except serving persons being relieved after earning their pension. SC/ST/OBC candidates applying against the unreserved vacancy get no age relaxation. Ex-servicemen must enclose the Discharge Certificate (Discharge Book) signed by the specified authority. Candidature stays provisional until documents are verified, and fraudulent claims of ex-servicemen status lead to action.

Sub Inspector in Pay Level 6 is treated as equivalent to Naib Subedar in Army, and Inspector in Pay Level 7 as equivalent to Subedar. Pay is counted at the Level 6 or 7 of the post substantively held, not one granted under financial upgradation such as MACPS.

Candidates from far flung areas (North Eastern Regions, Andaman & Nicobar Islands, Lakshadweep, Lahaul & Spiti District of Himachal Pradesh, UT of Ladakh etc.) have 27.01.2027, 6.00 PM as the last date of receipt of the hard copy.

important_instructions: Applications received after the closing date for any reason, such as wrongly addressed envelopes, delivery elsewhere or postal delay, will not be entertained. Incomplete applications, such as those without photograph, signature, enclosures or fee where applicable, will be summarily rejected. Regular employees of Government Departments, Autonomous Bodies, PSUs and government funded research agencies must enclose a NOC. If it is not available, they may enclose a self-attested copy of the request made to the employer, but must produce the NOC when sought, with vigilance clearance recorded, or the candidature will be terminated. Applicants must disclose any close or blood relative employed in CSIR-CMERI, CSIR or any CSIR laboratory. Canvassing or bringing influence is a disqualification. No Travel Allowance will be reimbursed for the Physical Test or Written Examination. Applications cannot be withdrawn. Wrong information or process violation leads to disqualification and a bar from future recruitment processes of the Institute. Malpractice leads to cancellation of candidature and possible prosecution under the Public Examinations (Prevention of Unfair Means) Act, 2024. The Institute may amend, delete or add terms, and may fill or not fill the post. The English version prevails over the Hindi version. Selection updates and any corrigendum or addendum will appear only on https://www.cmeri.res.in.

content_sections.heading: About the Institute
content_sections.text: CSIR-CMERI, Durgapur is described in the notice as a premier institute under CSIR and the only national laboratory dedicated to mechanical engineering. Its mission is to develop cost-effective, value-added technologies in mechanical engineering and allied domains, and to contribute to national skill development initiatives. The advertised post is at its Centre of Excellence for Farm Machinery in Ludhiana. The notice states that CSIR encourages women candidates to apply.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The applicant must be a citizen of India. PwBD candidates are not eligible, as the notice says the job is not suitable for them. The post is unreserved. Annexure-A of the notice lists JCO ranks and pay levels and the equivalence between Armed Forces and Paramilitary Forces. Sub Inspector in Pay Level 6 is treated as equivalent to Naib Subedar in Army, and Inspector in Pay Level 7 as equivalent to Subedar. Pay is counted at the Level 6 or 7 of the post substantively held, not one granted under financial upgradation such as MACPS. The upper age limit is 28 years. Age, qualifications and experience are counted as on the last date for submission of applications, 12.01.2027, including for candidates from far flung areas. Date of birth in the application must match the Matriculation/Secondary certificate, and no later change is considered. Ex-servicemen: the upper age limit is relaxable up to 03 years after deduction of the military service rendered from the actual age as on the closing date. The relaxation follows Government of India rules for Ex-Servicemen under Rule 2(c) of the Ex-Servicemen (Re-employment in Central Civil Services and Posts) Rules. It is not applicable to serving Armed Forces and Paramilitary personnel, except serving persons being relieved after earning their pension. SC/ST/OBC candidates applying against the unreserved vacancy get no age relaxation. Ex-servicemen must enclose the Discharge Certificate (Discharge Book) signed by the specified authority. Candidature stays provisional until documents are verified, and fraudulent claims of ex-servicemen status lead to action.

rows.essential_qualification: Ex-servicemen, JCO in Army or equivalent in other Paramilitary Forces with five years experience in the work of security
rows.desirable: Good communication skill in Hindi & English with knowledge of computer, modern fire-fighting, watch and ward security monitoring systems

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Total emoluments of approximately Rs. 67,000/- per month are counted on the minimum of the scale plus admissible allowances including House Rent Allowance for Ludhiana, Punjab. The post carries Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance and Transport Allowance as admissible to Central Government employees and applicable to Council employees at Ludhiana (Class 'Y' City). Medical facilities, Leave Travel Concession and Children's Education Allowance are available as per CSIR/Government of India rules. Accommodation as per CSIR allotment rules depends on availability; if it is given, HRA is not provided. The incumbent may have to stay in a CoEFM staff quarter. The selected candidate will be governed by the National Pension System or Extant Pension System based on defined contributions as adopted by CSIR. Probation is two years from taking over charge; it may be extended or curtailed by the Competent Authority, after which confirmation is considered under extant rules. The post is an Isolated category post entitled to Career Advancement as prescribed by CSIR. The normal place of posting is CoEFM, Ludhiana, but the appointee can be posted to any section or division of any CSIR laboratory, institute, field or regional centre in India.

content_sections.heading: CSIR-CMERI Security Assistant Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice gives the job requirement as responsibility for day-to-day security arrangements of the Centre, including: Office premises and campus, guest house, staff quarters and similar buildings of the Centre. Intelligence, vigilance, firefighting and safety standards of the estate, buildings, residential quarters, office premises, guest house and reception. Round-the-clock vigil and regulation of movement of persons and goods to and from the Centre campus. Liaison with local Police and other authorities, audit, and monitoring of the security contract. Supervising and controlling the regular/outsourced security personnel deployed for security duty, and maintenance of records. Any other work assigned by the Competent Authority.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection has three steps after scrutiny: the applications are first scrutinised prima facie on the documents sent. Candidates with the prescribed qualifications and age are then invited to a Physical and Personality Assessment Test, which is qualifying in nature. Those who qualify are invited to a Competitive Written Examination. The final merit list is prepared on written examination performance. The notice does not mention an interview. Hilly Area covers candidates belonging to hill areas of Garhwal, Kumaon, Himachal Pradesh, Gorkhas, Dogras, Marathas, Kashmir Valley, Leh and Ladakh regions, North Eastern States and Sikkim. The Personality Assessment Test is OMR-based or computer-based objective multiple choice, with one mark per correct answer and no negative marking. The minimum threshold marks shall not be less than 30%. The written examination merit list includes only those securing the minimum threshold marks, which shall not be less than 35%. Questions are in English and Hindi; the written examination can be taken in either. The standard of both tests is Class XII. Ties in aggregate marks are resolved in this order: older date of birth ranks higher; earlier acquisition of the essential degree ranks higher; alphabetical order of first names.
